title: COCOMI Urges Public Participation in October 31 Rally Against Alleged ‘Proxy War’
summary: Rally to proceed from Tiddim Ground to Thau Ground, with organisers calling for an end to the alleged proxy war in Manipur
body:
Imphal: The Coordinating Committee on Manipur Integrity (COCOMI) has appealed to the people of Manipur to participate in a rally scheduled for October 31, demanding an end to what it describes as a “proxy war” in the state.

COCOMI convenor YK Dhiren made the appeal during a press conference held at the committee’s office in Lamphel on Wednesday.

Representatives of several organisations attended the briefing, including COCOMI, the Joint Tribe Council (JTC), the Foothill Naga Coordination Committee (FNCC), the Naga People’s Union, Imphal (NPUI), and Naga Humanitarian Aid Manipur (NHACM).

According to the announcement, the rally will begin at Tiddim Ground and proceed to Thau Ground, where participants are expected to raise their demand for an end to the alleged proxy war in Manipur.

COCOMI has urged members of the public to join the rally and support its call for addressing the ongoing conflict-related concerns in the state.

The term “proxy war” reflects the organisers’ characterisation of the situation.
